Receiving a handoff

The TAR package contains the complete selected files and their reviewed source metadata.

Receive it with the installed command, then reopen the receiving library:

starforge inbox library collections receive
  --archive /private/handoff.tar
  --out /private/received
  --state /private/receiver

Use collections serve --state /private/receiver to continue here.
